story_overview: A gentle ten-scene bedtime nursery story about a small friendly golden star who wakes in the moonlit sky, sparkles above soft clouds, catches the attention of a curious child, and sends warm golden light across the sleeping world. The story moves from wide magical sky views to cozy bedroom wonder, then follows the star over rooftops, forests, hills, and shimmering clouds before ending with the child waving goodnight beneath a sky full of twinkling stars. Keep the star design consistent in every scene: a small rounded five-point golden star with a friendly smiling face, soft glowing edges, tiny sparkling motes, and a warm reassuring expression. Keep the child design consistent: a young child in soft pajamas with wide curious eyes, warmly lit by bedroom lamplight and cool moonlight. Overall style is whimsical storybook animation, soft-edged painterly illustration, dreamy glow, child-friendly composition, deep night blues balanced with gold, silver, pastel white, and warm bedroom light.
